summary: Invoice management application with compliance validation for required fields including supplier information, invoice details, line items, and totals
architectural_notes: Invoice must validate all required fields before allowing PDF generation
Form validation should display all errors to user before submission
known_issues: Invoice PDF generation currently allows download without required compliance fields
